entries.zh: 侵占；强行夺取（据他人财物土地为己有）
entries.en: to take by force, snatch away; to encroach upon and seize (another's property or land)
entries.notes: 汉字'侵占'与西语词头'tomar, arrebatar'互证清晰；注音栏两处声调污损（T99），依规程降低。

entries.zh: 强占；霸占（强行占据他人产业）
entries.en: to seize and occupy by force; to usurp, take possession of
entries.notes: 与上条同族词头（外加椭圆圈示参证），义证清晰；注音首字声调污损（T99）。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 仅存汉字栏'唔脉'，西语词头与注音栏俱空，义项无从确定。

entries.zh: 诊脉；省察脉象（按脉诊病）
entries.en: to take the pulse; to feel and examine the pulse in diagnosis
entries.notes: 西语'tomar el pulso'义证明确，汉字'省脉'（省=省察）相合；注音有'ua me/may me'两读且声调多处污损（T99）。

entries.zh: 打而不带（字面；确切义项存疑）
entries.en: to strike and not take/carry away (literal reading; sense uncertain)
entries.notes: 西语词头转写残泐（'vulvempino'难解），汉字'打不带'字面可读而义不能定。

entries.zh: 打架；相斗
entries.en: to fight, attack each other; (of fowls) to grapple and trample each other
entries.notes: 汉字'相踏'与注音互证为相斗义；西语词头'tomarse las aves'（禽鸟相搏）稍隔，赖斗鸡语境推断。

entries.zh: 相带；结伴同行（互相携领）
entries.en: to go together, keep each other company; to lead or carry each other along
entries.notes: 汉字'相带'与注音互证清晰；西语词头'tomarse los animales'（兽类相随）所指仅部分相合。

entries.zh: 记诵；默记于心（凭记忆念出）
entries.en: to commit to memory; to recite from memory, memorize

entries.zh: 做记号；记下备忘
entries.en: to make a note of; to mark down so as to remember

entries.zh: 紧握其手而取；执手不放
entries.en: to take hold gripping with the hand; to clasp tightly
entries.notes: 西语词头'紧握其手而取'明确；汉字'执带处'仅'执'与取义相合，余字未解。

entries.zh: 降火；服药清热退火
entries.en: to take medicine to reduce internal heat (fever); to lower the body's 'fire'

entries.zh: 考察；查核（官吏任满政绩审查）
entries.en: to take the residencia (judicial review of an official's term of office); to investigate, examine
entries.notes: 'tomar residencia'为西属殖民地官吏任满审查制度，与'考察'互证；注音两处声调污损（T99）。

entries.zh: 查判；查究裁断
entries.en: to examine and judge; to investigate and pass sentence
entries.notes: 与第12条同西语词头（椭圆圈示参证），汉字'查判'义合；注音末字声调污损（T99）。

entries.zh: 攻劫；攻占（王国）
entries.en: to conquer a kingdom; to attack and seize by force

entries.zh: 生銑（字面；确切义项存疑）
entries.en: (literal character reading; sense uncertain)
entries.notes: 西语词头'tomarse lecin'转写残泐难解，汉字'生銑'（注音 sien）词义不明，无从定夺。

entries.zh: 乘凉；纳凉
entries.en: to take the cool/fresh air; to enjoy the cool (in the shade)

entries.zh: 提动；提起移动、搬动
entries.en: to lift and move; to take up and carry, stir
entries.notes: 汉字'提动'与注音互证清晰；西语词头'tomar auello spesa'部分残泐（'spesa'未解），仅'tomar aquello'（取彼物）相合。

entries.zh: 是他（应管）的事；归他负责
entries.en: it is his business; it is up to him, he takes charge of it

entries.zh: 是我（应管）的事；归我负责
entries.en: it is my business; it is up to me, I take charge of it
entries.notes: 义证清晰（'tomar a mi cargo'对'是我事'）；注音首字声调污损（T99）依规程降低。

entries.zh: 那是我（应管）的事；此事归我负责
entries.en: that matter is mine to attend to; it is my business
entries.notes: '是我事那'（'那'为话题语）与西语'mi cargo'互证；注音首字声调污损（T99）。

entries.zh: 提定；指定、认定（提示而定）
entries.en: to take a sign/signal; to point out and fix, determine
entries.notes: 西语'tomar señal'（取记号）与汉字'提定'仅部分相合，且注音末字声调污损（T99）。

entries.zh: 提进去；携带入内（如掖于衣下带入）
entries.en: to take and carry (it) in; to carry it in under one's cloak
entries.notes: 汉字'提进去'与注音互证清晰；西语词头近'tomar y llevarlo debajo del manto'（掖于衣内携入），注音一处声调污损（T99）。
